name: VIP Space Odyssey
developer: VIP Property Development Thailand (VIP Thailand Group)
shortDescription: Mixed-use development in southern Rawai with 574 condo units and 23 pool villas, studios to 2 bedrooms from 29 sqm, 0.6 km from Rawai Beach.
description:
VIP Space Odyssey is a mixed-use development by VIP Property Development Thailand in southern Phuket, between Rawai Beach and Nai Harn Beach and under 3 km from Promthep Cape. The developer describes four condominium buildings of up to 8 floors with 574 condominium units, plus 23 private pool villas, on about 25,600 sqm; it is EIA approved and the architecture takes space exploration as its theme. FazWaz lists 619 units, so the unit total differs by source. Completion is announced for the fourth quarter of 2028, and the developer's page shows construction progress photos with piling works under way in 2026.
Unit layouts published by the developer: studios of about 29 to 32 sqm (Types A, C and D), one-bedroom units of 32 and 45 sqm (Types E and G), two-bedroom units of 60 and 69 sqm (Types B and F) and private pool villas from about 120 sqm. Renders show a rooftop infinity pool with sea views, a restaurant, a fitness center, a kids club and playgrounds, and the developer also lists a co-working space and a convenience store.
Ownership: the developer lists freehold and leasehold; FazWaz lists common-area fees of THB 60 per sqm per month, a sinking fund of THB 400 per sqm and a freehold premium of THB 10,000 per sqm. Rawai Beach is about 0.6 km away in a straight line, Rawai Park 1.3 km, Yanui Beach 2.0 km and Promthep Cape 2.8 km. Prices are advertised by portals from about THB 4.4 million and change; confirm availability and terms before reserving.

researchNotes: No official site verified. Scale conflict: FazWaz 619 units / 5 buildings / 8 floors; other sources 300 units, 19 pool villas, or 4 buildings. FazWaz type: mixed-use. Ownership: portals say freehold (foreign quota 49%) with freehold premium THB 10,000/sqm; leasehold also mentioned. A developer rental guarantee is advertised by agents; deliberately not repeated here. Studio prices not extracted; THB 4.4M is a portal-advertised start (a 2024 article said 4.25M). | Images 2026-11-25: 4 construction progress photos from the developer page vipthailand.com/projects/vip-space-odessey/ (Mar-Aug 2026 updates), cropped to the photo area. Page text: developer VIP Property Development Thailand; EIA approved; mixed-use (condominiums, private villas, retail); multiple pools, fitness, kids club, co-working space; between Rawai Beach and Nai Harn Beach. Site works and piling visible in 2026, so status set to Under construction. | Developer page (2026-11-25): EIA approved, mixed-use with condominiums, private villas and retail, pools, fitness centre, kids club and co-working space; no unit count on the page. Status changed to Under construction from construction photos Mar-Aug 2026. | Images 2026-11-25: Gallery and unit layouts replaced with the full set from vipthailand.com/projects/vip-space-odessey/ (14 renders, 2 progress photos, 7 unit-type layout boards, 1 pool villa layout). | Developer page factsheet read 2026-11-25: 574 condo units, 4 buildings, 8 floors, 23 pool villas (freehold available), project area ~25,600 sqm, studio/1BR/2BR from 29 to 120+ sqm, freehold and leasehold, completion expected Q4 2028. Unit bathrooms for studio/1BR/2BR assumed 1/1/2 (from FazWaz unit rows). 2026-11-27 SEO audit: title/meta description updated.
